overview: The meeting reviewed Design Option C 3.4 for the Medford High School building project, focusing on its spatial layout, site navigation benefits, and the timeline impacts of its construction phasing.

items.title: Design Option C 3.4 (Starship Academy)
items.summary: Jenny Graham and Matt Rice discussed Option C 3.4, explaining how its arced elevations create distinct entrances for different programs and how its construction phasing could eliminate the need for modular classrooms while potentially extending the project's overall duration.

subject: High School Design Option C 3.4 Review
